name: Ameya Precision Engineers Ltd.
summary: Ameya Precision Engineers Ltd. is a precision engineering company that manufactures high-end engineering components and assemblies. The company specializes in producing high-precision machined components such as shafts, stems, valve components, actuator parts, precision trim parts, and hard-facing overlays. It also offers specialized components like precision gears and bearings. Ameya Precision Engineers provides custom manufacturing services based on client designs, along with specialized processes including hard-facing and overlay of wear and corrosion-resistant alloys conforming to ASME procedures. Additionally, the company offers design and development, prototyping, reverse engineering, tooling and mold design, testing, and inspection services. Its primary industry focus is precision engineering, serving sectors such as oil and gas, power generation, chemicals, water and wastewater management, and defense, with a particular emphasis on valve and pump manufacturing. The company targets global original equipment manufacturers, deriving a significant portion of its revenue from export markets including the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Slovenia, Austria, and Brazil, while also expanding its domestic presence in India. Operations are conducted from a manufacturing facility in Pune, Maharashtra, equipped with advanced CNC machinery for complex machining and assembly. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified.
